dialogues.label: 课文（一）
dialogues.headingEn: I've been here for more than two months

lines.zh: 我来了两个多月了，对这儿的生活差不多已经习惯了，不过有的地方还不太习惯。总觉得这儿的气候特别干燥，宿舍周围不太干净，也不太安静，食堂里的菜太油腻。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ lái le liǎng ge duō yuè le, duì zhèr de shēnghuó chàbuduō yǐjing xíguàn le, búguò yǒude dìfang hái bú tài xíguàn. Zǒng juéde zhèr de qìhòu tèbié gānzào, sùshè zhōuwéi bú tài gānjìng, yě bú tài ānjìng, shítáng lǐ de cài tài yóunì.
lines.en: I’ve been here more than two months and I’m almost used to life here, but some things still feel unfamiliar. The climate feels especially dry; around the dorm it’s not very clean or quiet; cafeteria food is too greasy.

lines.zh: 我每天早上七点多才起床，所以常常没时间吃早饭，喝杯牛奶就去上课了。不过，课间休息的时候，我可以去喝杯咖啡，吃一块点心。中午我去食堂吃午饭。因为吃饭的人很多，所以常常要等四五分钟才能买到饭。吃完饭，我回宿舍看书或者听一会儿音乐。中午我从来不睡午觉。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ měi tiān zǎoshang qī diǎn duō cái qǐchuáng, suǒyǐ chángcháng méi shíjiān chī zǎofàn, hē bēi niúnǎi jiù qù shàngkè le. Búguò, kèjiān xiūxi de shíhou, wǒ kěyǐ qù hē bēi kāfēi, chī yí kuài diǎnxin. Zhōngwǔ wǒ qù shítáng chī wǔfàn. Yīnwèi chīfàn de rén hěn duō, suǒyǐ chángcháng yào děng sì-wǔ fēnzhōng cái néng mǎidào fàn. Chī wán fàn, wǒ huí sùshè kànshū huòzhě tīng yíhuìr yīnyuè. Zhōngwǔ wǒ cónglái bú shuì wǔjiào.
lines.en: I get up a little after seven, so I often skip breakfast and just drink milk before class. During breaks I can get coffee and a snack. At noon I eat in the cafeteria — often wait four or five minutes. After lunch I read or listen to music in the dorm. I never nap at noon.

lines.zh: 下午，有时候上两节课，有时候自己学习。四点以后我去体育馆锻炼身体，跑步、游泳、打球或者跟老师学打太极拳。我很喜欢运动，每天都坚持锻炼一个小时，所以身体很好。晚饭后我常常散一会儿步，有时跟朋友聊聊天儿，然后就开始复习功课。听半个小时课文录音，练习会话，预习生词和课文。生词要记住，课文要念熟，所以每天晚上一般要复习、预习两三个小时，常常学到十一点多才睡觉。我每天都很忙，但过得很愉快。我很感谢父母给我这个机会，让我来中国留学。原来打算学一年，现在我觉得一年时间太短了，准备再延长一年。
lines.pinyin: Xiàwǔ, yǒushíhou shàng liǎng jié kè, yǒushíhou zìjǐ xuéxí. Sì diǎn yǐhòu wǒ qù tǐyùguǎn duànliàn shēntǐ, pǎobù, yóuyǒng, dǎqiú huòzhě gēn lǎoshī xué dǎ tàijíquán. Wǒ hěn xǐhuan yùndòng, měi tiān dōu jiānchí duànliàn yí ge xiǎoshí, suǒyǐ shēntǐ hěn hǎo. Wǎnfàn hòu wǒ chángcháng sàn yíhuìr bù, yǒushí gēn péngyou liáo liaotiānr, ránhòu jiù kāishǐ fùxí gōngkè. Tīng bàn ge xiǎoshí kèwén lùyīn, liànxí huìhuà, yùxí shēngcí hé kèwén. Shēngcí yào jìzhù, kèwén yào niàn shú, suǒyǐ měi tiān wǎnshang yìbān yào fùxí, yùxí liǎng-sān ge xiǎoshí, chángcháng xué dào shíyī diǎn duō cái shuìjiào. Wǒ měi tiān dōu hěn máng, dàn guò de hěn yúkuài. Wǒ hěn gǎnxiè fùmǔ gěi wǒ zhège jīhuì, ràng wǒ lái Zhōngguó liúxué. Yuánlái dǎsuàn xué yì nián, xiànzài wǒ juéde yì nián shíjiān tài duǎn le, zhǔnbèi zài yáncháng yì nián.
lines.en: In the afternoon I sometimes have two classes, sometimes study alone. After four I exercise at the gym — run, swim, play ball, or learn tai chi. I stick to an hour a day, so I’m healthy. After dinner I walk or chat, then review: half an hour of recordings, conversation practice, preview vocab and text. Vocab must stick; texts must be fluent — usually two or three hours, often until past eleven. I’m busy but happy. I’m grateful to my parents for this chance. I planned one year; now it feels too short, so I’ll extend another year.

dialogues.label: 课文（二）
dialogues.headingEn: I practice for an hour every day

lines.speaker: 关经理
lines.zh: 你好，王老师。每天都起得这么早吗？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ hǎo, Wáng lǎoshī. Měi tiān dōu qǐ de zhème zǎo ma?
lines.en: Hello, Teacher Wang. Do you get up this early every day?

lines.speaker: 王老师
lines.zh: 对，因为我练气功，所以每天五点多就起来了。
lines.pinyin: Duì, yīnwèi wǒ liàn qìgōng, suǒyǐ měi tiān wǔ diǎn duō jiù qǐlai le.
lines.en: Yes — because I practice qigong, I get up a little after five.

lines.speaker: 关经理
lines.pinyin: Liàn le duō cháng shíjiān le?
lines.en: How long have you been practicing?

lines.speaker: 王老师
lines.pinyin: Yǐjing liàn le hǎo jǐ nián le.
lines.en: For quite a few years already.

lines.speaker: 关经理
lines.pinyin: Měi tiān liàn duō cháng shíjiān?

lines.speaker: 王老师
lines.zh: 不一定。有时候练一个钟头，有时候半个钟头。
lines.pinyin: Bù yídìng. Yǒushíhou liàn yí ge zhōngtóu, yǒushíhou bàn ge zhōngtóu.
lines.en: It varies — sometimes an hour, sometimes half an hour.

lines.speaker: 王老师
lines.zh: 挺好的。练气功对身体很有好处。以前我有好几种慢性病呢，高血压、失眠，坚持练了几年，我的这些病差不多都好了。你也来练练吧。
lines.pinyin: Tǐng hǎo de. Liàn qìgōng duì shēntǐ hěn yǒu hǎochu. Yǐqián wǒ yǒu hǎo jǐ zhǒng mànxìngbìng ne, gāoxuèyā, shīmián, jiānchí liàn le jǐ nián, wǒ de zhèxiē bìng chàbuduō dōu hǎo le. Nǐ yě lái liànlian ba.
lines.en: Pretty good. Qigong helps a lot. I used to have several chronic problems — hypertension, insomnia — after years of practice they’re almost gone. You should try it too.

lines.speaker: 关经理
lines.zh: 练气功必须坚持天天练，“三天打鱼，两天晒网”不行。我也很想练，但是工作太忙，没有时间。
lines.pinyin: Liàn qìgōng bìxū jiānchí tiāntiān liàn, “sān tiān dǎ yú, liǎng tiān shài wǎng” bù xíng. Wǒ yě hěn xiǎng liàn, dànshì gōngzuò tài máng, méiyǒu shíjiān.
lines.en: You have to practice every day — “three days fishing, two days drying nets” won’t do. I’d like to, but work is too busy.

notes.title: 副词“好”强调数量多、时间久
notes.body: 副词“好”用在“一”“几”“多”“久”等词前，强调数量多、时间久。例如：已经练了好几年了。 Example-sentence pinyin not printed in the book; standard pinyin added.

example.pinyin: Yǐjing liàn le hǎo jǐ nián le.
example.en: I’ve already practiced for quite a few years.

notes.title: 三天打鱼，两天晒网
notes.body: 谚语。比喻做事时断时续，不能坚持。 Example-sentence pinyin not printed in the book; standard pinyin added.

example.pinyin: “Sān tiān dǎ yú, liǎng tiān shài wǎng” bù xíng.
example.en: “Three days fishing, two days drying nets” won’t work.

notes.title: 时量补语：动作或状态持续时间
notes.body: 表达动作或状态持续的时间时汉语用时量补语。询问要说“多长时间（了）”。动词不带宾语时：主语＋动词（+了）＋时量补语。带宾语时可重复动词，或把时量放在动词和宾语之间。 Example-sentence pinyin not printed in the book; standard pinyin added.

example.zh: 我每天都坚持锻炼一个小时。
example.pinyin: Wǒ měi tiān dōu jiānchí duànliàn yí ge xiǎoshí.
example.en: I stick to exercising for one hour every day.

notes.title: 时量补语与宾语
notes.body: 动词带宾语（或离合词）时，可以重复动词，时量补语放在重复的动词后边；也可以不重复，时量补语放在动词和宾语之间。宾语是人称代词时，时量补语要放在宾语后边。 Example-sentence pinyin not printed in the book; standard pinyin added.

example.zh: 她学汉语学了两个多月了。
example.pinyin: Tā xué Hànyǔ xué le liǎng ge duō yuè le.
example.en: She’s been studying Chinese for more than two months.
